title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-28
source: Recorded By Mason Taylor on a Nakamichi 550 Cassette Deck, on crome tapes, with Nakamichi microphones; Transferred on Mason's restored Nak550

ai_review.summary: A listenable Red Rocks rain‑out recording with audible rain patter; the show is enjoyed despite modest audio fidelity.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers note that this Mason tape captures a historic Red Rocks performance where rain was falling, and the sound includes the patter of rain on the gear. The audio isn’t as clear as other copies but remains listenable, and fans appreciated the night’s vibe enough to give it above‑average marks.

ai_rating.rationale: Average show appreciation (4★) tempered by recording limitations (3★). With limited detail, the combined rating lands around a solid mid‑range score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rain noise audible on the tape; not as crisp as other copies but still listenable. No specific mention of soundboard or audience mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure; reviewers simply note overall enjoyment of the night.
